production.price_source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-11-16: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, about $0.039 per image)
production.ceiling_note: The renderer reserves US$0.20 before each request; the expected spend is about US$0.16.
production.order: Generate b03 first (the bird's beak must read as IN its water dish at 180 px), inspect it at 900/360/250/180 px and in the centered 4:5 crop, then b01, b02 and b04. A rejected output is reported with its cost; a redo needs a changed prompt in a new revision.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not even on the pet's collar, bowl or bed. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person, the pet and the pet's thing inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person and this one pet are in the photo; there is nobody else and no other animal, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pet: The pet and what it does with its own thing are the most obvious part of the photo: the camera is at the pet's level a few steps away, the animal is a real, natural-looking animal with correct anatomy, and the person looks at the pet, not at the camera.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

assets.item: I have a dog. Its name is Max. / The dog plays with its ball.

reference_file.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin, navy crew-neck T-shirt) drinks coffee from a white mug at a wooden table in his bright kitchen (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis. Keep his face, short dark curly hair, clean-shaven face, warm medium-brown skin and build exactly, and his navy crew-neck T-shirt. Create a new photograph in a green city park on a sunny day: Luis crouches on the grass next to his dog, a friendly medium-sized brown dog with a red collar. The dog plays with its ball: it holds a bright yellow tennis ball in its mouth, tail up, facing Luis, and Luis smiles at the dog with one hand near its head. The dog and the yellow ball are large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and Luis's face is fully visible in three-quarter view. Trees and a path are softly visible behind them.

assets.item: I have a cat. Its name is Luna. / The cat is on its bed.

reference_file.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, warm brown skin, white blouse under a bright blue blazer) writes in a large notebook at a wooden desk by a bright window in her home study (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Sofia. Keep her face, long curly dark hair, warm brown skin and build exactly, and her white blouse under her bright blue blazer, with no badge and no card. Create a new photograph in her bright living room in the daytime: Sofia sits at the end of a light sofa and smiles down at her cat. On the floor right beside the sofa is the cat's own bed, a round soft grey cat bed with a raised rim; a grey-and-white cat lies in it, awake and calm, clearly ON its bed. The cat in its bed is large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and Sofia's face is fully visible in three-quarter view. A window with daylight and a small plant are softly visible behind them.

assets.item: I have a bird. Its name is Rio. / The bird drinks its water.

reference_file.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt) sits at a wooden kitchen table and bites a red apple (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, skin tone and build exactly, and his burgundy button shirt. Create a new photograph in his bright kitchen in the daytime: Diego stands beside a white metal birdcage on the kitchen counter and smiles at his bird. Inside the cage, a small yellow-and-green parakeet bends down and drinks its water: its beak is in a small clear water dish full of water at the front of the cage. The cage, the bird and the water dish are large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and Diego's face is fully visible in three-quarter view behind the cage, not hidden by its bars.

assets.item: I have a rabbit. Its name is Coco. / The rabbit eats its food.

reference_file.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans) sits on a light-grey sofa and reads an open hardcover book (A1+ 1.2).

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Keep her face, long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin and build exactly, and her sage-green overshirt over a white top, jeans. Create a new photograph in the small green garden behind her house on a sunny day: Ana kneels on the grass and smiles at her rabbit. In front of her, a white-and-brown rabbit eats its food from its own small blue bowl full of carrot pieces and green lettuce, its nose in the bowl. The rabbit and its blue bowl are large, near the camera and in sharp focus, and Ana's face is fully visible in three-quarter view. A wooden fence and flowers are softly visible behind them.
